verdict.rationale: Check is API-first: the docs cover API operations for companies, workplaces, employees, payrolls (create, preview, approve, delete), contractors, benefits and tax documents, plus webhooks, a CLI and an MCP server. The embedded UI Components are described as easy to swap out for custom UI, which implies their functionality is reachable through the API. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of API/UI parity (e.g., whether Console-only settings such as webhook management or Component-only flows like tax-form signing are fully exposed via API), and independent hands-on corroboration.
